verdict.rationale: Python instrumentation is well documented. The modular Python SDK offers `auto_instrument=True` zero-config tracing and `@tracer.chain`/`@tracer.tool` decorators for manual spans, built on OpenTelemetry and OpenInference. JS/TS coverage rests on documented auto-instrumentation for the JS frameworks Mastra and Vercel AI SDK, plus the npm-distributed `@arizeai/phoenix-cli setup` for tracing setup. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented first-party TypeScript tracing SDK (manual span APIs and package reference; the cited TS SDK is for evaluations), and independent or hands-on corroboration of JS/TS instrumentation.
